title: Department Root and Induction Method
purpose: Establish all departments as peer governed entities under a shared department root and define the minimum induction process for new departments.

constitutional_rules.rule: All departments SHALL be represented as peer directories under a common department root.
No department SHALL be structurally privileged by directory location.
A department is not governed until it has a local SSOT and local AGENTS.md.
Department induction SHALL NOT imply claim maturity, validation, or proof_app contribution.
Each department SHALL declare its scope, dependencies, interpretation boundaries, and prohibited promotions.
Departments MAY define local interpretation frameworks but MAY NOT redefine global primitives.

induction_steps: Declare canonical owner for local artifacts.
Declare dependencies on Global Core and other departments.

implementation.note: This patch authorizes cleanup and future restructuring but does not itself modify existing SSOT layout.
